name: deshi-monorepo
description: Deshi monorepo — the publishable `deshi` compiler package and an example site that consumes it.

scripts.build: bun run --filter deshi build && bun run --filter deshi-playground build
scripts.dev: bun run build:compiler && bun run --filter deshi-playground dev
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter deshi typecheck && bun run --filter deshi-playground typecheck
